description: Default compression behavior: serve uses connect/compression middleware. Sends Accept-Encoding: gzip and inspects whether body is decompressed by fetch. The 'vary: Accept-Encoding' is the easy signal. Stage 7e slice 2 promoted this case to dual-target — the reference and irserve both emit Vary on a compressible (CSS) response, even when the body itself is below the 1024-byte threshold (and so no compression actually applies).
